Timing belt, pulleys, intake manifold, and wiring harness stubs are visible.
No VIN plate, engine code stamp, or part number sticker is legible anywhere in the photo.

claims.evidence: No Toyota logo, casting mark, or Camry-specific part number is legible in photo 0.

claims.claim: 5x (likely referring to 5S-FE or similar engine code) old model
claims.evidence: No engine code stamp or ID plate visible in photo 0 to confirm the code.
Import origin cannot be confirmed from a photo of the bare engine; no shipping tag, customs sticker, or container photo shown.
No warranty document, receipt, or shop signage shown; a verbal guarantee from a stranger cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually be the claimed Toyota Camry/5S-FE-type unit; mislabeling is common in used-parts resale.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp (usually on the block near the bellhousing) or a visible casting number/part sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified/generic used 4-cylinder engine, not as a confirmed Camry-fitment unit

risks.risk: Internal condition (compression, bearings, timing components) cannot be judged from a static photo; could be seized, low compression, or need major rebuild.
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine running/idling, plus a compression test reading if possible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working (worst case: non-running)

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ancillary parts (alternator, starter, sensors, intake components) not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos from the opposite side and front/rear of the engine showing all ancillaries intact.

risks.risk: 'Guarantee' may be unenforceable or non-existent in practice.
risks.proof: Photo of a written warranty card/receipt or the shop's physical signage and address.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sold with no effective warranty

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history (claimed 'old model' but true wear unknown) cannot be assessed visually.
risks.proof: Odometer photo from the donor vehicle or a mileage disclosure document, if available.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp/casting number to confirm it matches a Camry-fitment engine.
Video of the engine running to assess basic function (smoke, noise, idle stability).
Photos of the opposite side and rear of the engine to confirm all ancillaries are present.
Photo of any warranty card, receipt, or shop signage supporting the 'guarantee' claim.
response.reason: The item's value hinges entirely on confirming it is genuinely the claimed Toyota Camry engine type, but no engine code, VIN, or part number is legible in the single photo, so even a worst-case price tier cannot be assigned without that identifying shot.
